correctness.rationale: The Laplacian on complete two-community weighted graphs p,q>=2 (internal a,c>=0, cross b>0) decomposes into four commuting projectors with eigenvalues 0, b(p alpha+q), b(q gamma+p), b(p+q). The [2/2] Pade scalar r(s)=(1-s/2+s^2/12)/(1+s/2+s^2/12)>0, r(0)=1. Spectral reconstruction yields strictly positive cross-block and diagonal entries and two within-block offdiagonal rational functions whose quadratic numerators have one positive root if their leading coefficient is negative, none otherwise. This proves all-h entrywise positivity iff alpha<= (p+2q)/q and gamma<=(q+2p)/p, a single interval [0,H] otherwise, critical O(h^-2) decay and H_A~6/(b q epsilon). Positive definiteness does NOT by itself entail entrywise positivity.
